title: Закрытие прямых обходных путей изменения доступа
goal: Запретить прямую ORM-запись доступа из стандартных Django Admin форм, generic AI update, профиля и выключенного AD sync, сохранив резервный Admin-адаптер к каноническому сервису.
implementation_notes: Standard UserAdmin fields groups, user_permissions, is_staff, is_superuser, is_active are read-only/removed; forged POST cannot change them.
Separate active-superuser-only Admin route calls preview_role_assignment/apply_role_assignment, requires non-empty reason and server-owned django_admin_break_glass source.
Admin self-assignment is allowed only for active superuser and is always high-risk; direct permissions and technical groups are outside this route.
GroupAdmin permissions/membership read-only; Board.allowed_groups temporarily read-only until 00d.
access.users.update no longer accepts group_names and uses account lifecycle service for status/department.
Profile is_active uses the same disable/enable invariants; self-disable and last-superuser disable rejected.
LDAP checks ACCOUNTS_AD_GROUP_ROLE_SYNC before any role diff, rejects unknown mapping and never get_or_create unknown role.
Unused execute_tool confirmed_token path removed or invalid token fails closed.
acceptance_checks: Admin standard access fields cannot be submitted by forged POST.
Admin fallback preview/apply succeeds through the canonical service and records source, break-glass reason, actor/target and diff.
AI generic update preserves groups and technical groups.
AD sync false produces zero group writes.
Unknown AD mapping is rejected and audited safely.
Self-disable and last-superuser disable rejected from every profile/AI path.
AI confirmation executes only stored PendingAction payload.
independent_review: Security review of Admin/AI/profile/LDAP/direct-service matrix without write scope.
